coverageNotes: Narrows original component selection to burst/refill configuration; 005 covers limiter selection and 008 strict spacing.

questions.concept: Configure burst capacity separately from sustained refill
questions.context: Convex 1.41.0, @convex-dev/rate-limiter 0.3.2. The component is mounted. Each authenticated search consumes one token with `limit(ctx, "logSearch", { key: identity.tokenIdentifier, throws: true })` before inserting its row. `SECOND` is imported from the package. Set the named `logSearch` configuration.
questions.question: Which configuration allows a fresh burst of 10 searches, then replenishes capacity at one search per second?

options.rationale: Refills ten tokens each second rather than one.
Refills at the desired rate but permits only one initial request.
Capacity sets the initial burst while rate and period set sustained replenishment.
Refills at fixed ten-second boundaries, not one token each second after consumption.
